commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Exposito (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+3' Here is a change. Javi Puado is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
90+3' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Roberto Fernandez Jaen as he is replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
90+1' A cross by Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Pol Lozano is replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
88' Urko Gonzalez will be replaced by Exposito (Espanyol).
88' 1 - 1 GOAL! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Joan Garcia.
87' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' A clumsy foul by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle. It's a penalty to Girona! Let's see who's going to take it.

85' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom left corner as Joan Garcia produces a good save.

84' Yangel Herrera (Girona) finds himself some space inside the box and gets on the end of the corner. He lashes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an amazing save to deny him.
84' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
83' Here comes a substitution. Arnau Martinez (Girona) is given a rest as he is replaced by Donny van de Beek.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanpe (Girona) replaces Miguel Gutierrez.
83' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
82' Joan Garcia (Espanyol) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
82' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
79' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
78' Javi Puado (Espanyol) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
77' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) is replacing Bryan Gil.
76' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
75' Bryan Gil (Girona) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
74' Arnau Martinez (Girona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
72' Bryan Gil (Girona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
72' Portu (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
71' The ball is out of play. Girona will take a throw-in.
70' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Jofre and he is replaced by Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
69' Michel decides to make a substitution. Bojan Miovski will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Portu (Girona) for Arthur Melo.
69' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
67' Yangel Herrera (Girona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
64' Bryan Gil (Girona) tries to find Bojan Miovski, but he puts too much power on the pass.

63' Alex Kral (Espanyol) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Paulo Gazzaniga makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
61' The booking goes to Miguel Gutierrez (Girona).
61' A quickly taken corner by Girona.

61' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) commits a foul and Adrian Cordero immediately signals a free kick.
59' It's a throw-in for Espanyol.
56' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Alex Kral (Espanyol) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
55' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
55' A cross into the box from Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is cleared.
54' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
53' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

49' 1 - 0 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Jofre (Espanyol) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from mid range that easily beats the keeper. That makes it1:0.
48' Bryan Gil (Girona) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' The attendance is 23997.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Exposito (Espanyol) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45+2' Having seen unsporting behavior, Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Exposito (Espanyol) is the recipient.
45+2' The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Arthur Melo (Girona) will take a free kick in a very promising position.

41' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Girona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
39' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
39' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

38' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.

37' What a poor attempt! Pol Lozano (Espanyol) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
36' Espanyol work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
34' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
34' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Corner kick. Espanyol will have an opportunity.

33' Javi Puado (Espanyol) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Paulo Gazzaniga anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.
33' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
32' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

31' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Alex Kral (Espanyol) hacks down one of his opponents. Girona are awarded a free kick.
30' Yangel Herrera (Girona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
26' The keeper makes a simple save after Yangel Herrera (Girona) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

25' Javi Puado (Espanyol) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Paulo Gazzaniga.
24' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and it's Bojan Miovski (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
21' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) passes the ball onto Bojan Miovski, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
20' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
19' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Girona earn a free kick.
18' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
17' Bryan Gil (Girona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' Daley Blind (Girona) sends a long ball forward to Bryan Gil, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
12' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
11' A pass from Bryan Gil (Girona) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.
11' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

10' Bojan Miovski (Girona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
9' 18:82 – the ratio of ball possession.
7' Bojan Miovski (Girona) receives a reproachful look from Ladislav Krejci. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
6' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
5' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
4' Javi Puado (Espanyol) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
3' Ivan Martin (Girona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
1' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Girona will kick-off.
